notes.title: FAR S ULTRA - Last update is out now!
notes.content:
FUTURE AERO RACING S ULTRA LAST UPDATE

Last update 3.3.2.0 is live now on Steam with new features, improvements and fixes.

[previewyoutube=kvFDbN8N7Ms;full][/previewyoutube]

Below are the list of new features and fixes.

New features:

 New unlockable -> Retro Shader FX: back to 1994.
 New unlockable -> Pilot License.
 New XP system and adjusted all rewards.


Improvements:

 A.I. balancing.
 Improved all game menus design.
 Improved art in all tracks.
 Improved lighting system.
 Updated credits.


Fixes:

 Localization general fixes.
 Gamepad vibration fixes.
 General bug fixing.


Go to forum discussion to know more about this last update:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1007140/discussions/0/2993165479003163893/


Thanks to everyone for your support and enjoy the race!

notes.title: FAR S ULTRA - Update 3.3.1.0 is out now
notes.content:
FUTURE AERO RACING S ULTRA NEW UPDATE

Update 3.3.1.0 is live now on Steam with a new difficulty level, 40 car skins and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34329481/141bcc47f364d55f915c2374cbf68cb9c9ee1bbd.png

Below are the list of new features and fixes. New features:

 40 Car Skins ( 3 new skins unlockable by pilot level + 1 original for each car)
 Max level increased 25 to 40
 UI: icon showing a new unlocked element (Car skin, track, cup & game mode).
 New difficulty level (MIRROR): will be unlocked when all the difficulty levels are completed
 with gold.
 New in-game car camera.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34329481/e5935c74c9071e183964277335b7762d59a5a88c.jpg

Go to forum discussion to know more about this major update:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1007140/discussions/0/1607148447812423528/

Thanks to everyone for your support and enjoy the race!

notes.title: New input manager under QA.
notes.content:
The  new input manager is ready to be tested!  

This new input manager allow you to play with Xbox controllers , PS4 controller and Steam Controller.

Also, now we have controller vibration.

The first update is coming!

notes.title: FAR S ULTRA Available on Steam at 15% off.
notes.content:
Finally FAR S ULTRA is available on Steam.

Enjoy of this fast and futuristic arcade racing game indpired by F-zero and Ridge Racer games.

Play alone or with 4 friends in split-screen local multiplayer championships.

Get the 20 FAR Cups and bit the 30 challenges along the 15 tracks.

Get it now at 15% Off until Febraury 28th.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34329481/97bf4bcced9dbf7c3693f2b946d449346b72748d.jpg

Thanks a lot to everyone for your support!!
Enjoy the race!

notes.title: FAR S ULTRA is coming to Steam
notes.content:
Future Aero Racing S Ultra is coming to Steam this February 22th.

Enjoy of this fast and futuristic arcade racing game inspired  by the great  F-zero.

After release the last year on Xbox One , now it's coming to Steam with some improvements and 12 Steam Achievements.

Are you ready to show who is the best driver ?

Add now to your wishlist.
